en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ibrahim narrated to us from Muhammad b. `Isa b. `Ubayd from Yunus b. `Abd al-Rahman from al-Hasan b. Ziyad from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as). He said:
Surely, Allah wanted Islam to be your religion, so beautify its company with generosity and beautiful character.
